stem.text: Which statement correctly describes facilitated diffusion?

A.text: The process only occurs using channel proteins that change shape and that use energy provided by the cell.

B.text: The process occurs using channel proteins or carrier proteins that may or may not change shape.

C.text: The process occurs using channel proteins or carrier proteins that use energy provided by the cell.

D.text: The process only occurs using carrier proteins that create a gradient to move ions in opposite directions.
